info.title: Wise Owl Demeanor
info.description: Wise Owl Demeanor (known as Demeanor for .NET, Enterprise Edition through 5.x) is the original .NET obfuscator, shipping since 1999. Demeanor protects your intellectual property without breaking your app: it reads the compiled assembly first, recognizes framework patterns (ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Blazor, WPF, WinForms, MAUI, System.Text.Json, COM), and tells you in plain English what obfuscates cleanly, what breaks, and what code changes would fix it. Then it obfuscates: renames identifiers, encrypts strings, constants, and resources, obfuscates control flow, and injects anti-tamper and anti-debug protections. Per-company Enterprise licensing — one annual key, unlimited developers and build agents, no phone-home, no machine locking, no activation server. Optional Large Language Model (LLM) integration via a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server lets customers who already use an MCP-capable AI assistant — Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Continue.dev — drive the audit as a conversation; runs locally over stdio. Editions: Community (single-assembly renaming) / Enterprise (per company, full transform suite). Pricing and purchase: https://www.wiseowlsoftware.com/pricing.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for the obfuscated assembly.

options.name: --include-publics
options.description: Also obfuscate public/protected symbols. Without this flag, publicly visible types and members in library DLLs are preserved. Use for executables that are not referenced by other assemblies.

options.name: --include-deps
options.description: Also obfuscate co-located private dependency assemblies (transitive closure). System and third-party assemblies are loaded for reference only.

options.name: --names
options.description: Name generation mode: Alpha (a,b,c) or Unicode (Canadian Aboriginal Syllabics - most systems lack the font). [default: Alpha]

options.name: --prefix
options.description: Namespace prefix for obfuscated top-level types.

options.name: --no-aggressive
options.description: Disable aggressive renaming. By default (Enterprise), all renamed members share the same obfuscated name and property/event metadata is stripped.

options.name: --no-strings
options.description: Disable string encryption.

options.name: --no-constants
options.description: Disable integer constant encryption.

options.name: --no-resources
options.description: Disable encryption of embedded resources.

options.name: --no-virtual-rename
options.description: Disable MethodImpl-based virtual override renaming (Enterprise). When enabled, overrides of external methods like ToString and interface implementations are renamed.

options.name: --no-enum-deletion
options.description: Disable deletion of enum member fields (Enterprise). When enabled, all static literal fields on renamed enums are removed.

options.name: --no-anti-debug
options.description: Disable anti-debug detection (Enterprise). When enabled, debugger detection checks are scattered across method entry points.

options.name: --no-anti-tamper
options.description: Disable anti-tamper integrity verification (Enterprise). When enabled, a module initializer verifies the assembly file has not been modified post-build.

options.name: --no-call-hiding
options.description: Disable call hiding (delegate-backed relay methods that hide call targets from static analysis).

options.name: --proxy-threshold
options.description: Minimum IL body size (bytes) for same-assembly methods to be proxied. Default/minimum: 16. [default: 16]

options.name: --cfg
options.description: Control flow obfuscation level: Reorder (light), Predicates (medium), Flatten (maximum, default). [default: Flatten]

options.name: --no-cfg
options.description: Disable control flow obfuscation entirely.

options.name: --no-baml
options.description: Disable WPF BAML patching. When set, compiled XAML resources are left unmodified and all types/properties referenced in BAML are frozen from renaming instead.

options.name: --no-hinder-reflection
options.description: Disable reflection hindrance. When enabled (default at Enterprise): injects metadata constructs that hinder reflection-based tools and prevents ILDASM disassembly.

options.name: --keyfile
options.description: Strong name key file (.snk) for re-signing.

options.name: --keycontainer
options.description: Strong name key container for re-signing.

options.name: --no-rename
options.description: Disable renaming entirely (types, methods, fields, properties, events, parameters). A member-level [Obfuscation(Feature="rename", Exclude=false)] or [Obfuscation(Feature="rename-propagate", Exclude=false)] opts the marked symbol back in.

options.name: --no-types
options.description: Disable obfuscation of all type names.

options.name: --no-methods
options.description: Disable obfuscation of all method names.

options.name: --no-fields
options.description: Disable obfuscation of all field names.

options.name: --no-properties
options.description: Disable obfuscation of all property names. The PropertyUsageAnalyzer heuristic automatically protects data-bound and serialized properties.

options.name: --no-events
options.description: Disable obfuscation of all event names.

options.name: --no-parameters
options.description: Disable obfuscation of parameter names.

options.name: --no-enumerations
options.description: Disable obfuscation of enumeration types.

options.name: --no-resource-names
options.description: Disable obfuscation of managed resource names.

options.name: --no-serializable
options.description: Exclude serializable types and their serializable fields.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Exclude a type or member by fully-qualified name (repeatable).

options.name: --xr
options.description: Exclude types/members matching a regex pattern (repeatable).

options.name: --xa
options.description: Exclude an assembly from obfuscation by name (repeatable).

options.name: --add-assembly
options.description: Include a dynamically referenced assembly (repeatable).

options.name: --satellite-assemblies
options.description: Update resource names in satellite assemblies.

options.name: --sa-cultures
options.description: Specific cultures for satellite assembly processing (repeatable).

options.name: --prior-report
options.description: Prior version's JSON report for incremental obfuscation (preserves name mappings).

options.name: --report
options.description: Generate a JSON report mapping original to obfuscated names. Optionally pass a filename: `--report path.json`. Without a filename, the report is written next to the obfuscated assembly.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Simulate obfuscation: run the full pipeline (including the report) but write the obfuscated assembly to a discardable temp directory instead of the configured output directory. Use to preview the rename map and statistics without touching the real output.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Display verbose obfuscation statistics.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress all non-error output.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Preserve debug data (PDB) in the output assembly.

options.name: --no-logo
options.description: Suppress the startup banner.

options.name: --license
options.description: Base64-encoded license key. Also reads from DEMEANOR_LICENSE environment variable.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project root holding .demeanor/ (rules and resolved decisions). Defaults to the nearest ancestor of the input assembly that contains a .demeanor directory. The MSBuild integration always passes this explicitly.

options.name: --fail-on-pending-decisions
options.description: Exit non-zero if any needs-decision rule matched a symbol nobody has resolved. Those symbols are always left unrenamed; this turns that into a build failure instead of a report.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information
